name: cargo-tracker-css-build
description: CSS minification build tooling for cargo-tracker production container (cz-css-1004)

scripts.minify-css: find src/main/webapp/resources/css src/main/webapp/resources/leaflet -name '*.css' | xargs -I{} postcss {} --use cssnano -o {}
scripts.minify-css-verbose: find src/main/webapp/resources/css src/main/webapp/resources/leaflet -name '*.css' | while read f; do echo "Minifying: $f"; npx postcss "$f" --use cssnano -o "$f"; done
